CoreBlow 2.1.3

Highlights

  • Performance: 48.3% leaner npm publish tarball (202.2 MB -> 104.6 MB unpacked, 0 *.test.d.ts leaks).
  • Diagnostics: Added 'coreblow doctor --net' real RTT latency diagnostics and 'coreblow chat --go' companion desktop handoff.
  • Fleet Dispatcher: Safe fleet dispatcher (scripts/fleet-exec.mjs) with zero cross-repo runtime imports.
  • Parity & Quarantine: Legacy TUI quarantine (src/tui/legacy/) and 142/142 verified extension plugin manifests.
  • Supply Chain: 100% 40-char SHA-pinned GitHub Actions, CycloneDX SBOMs, and signed build provenance across all 26 fleet repositories.
